annotations.text:
A — BREAK THE RHYTHM

Read these left to right, in page order. The frames are deliberately different heights: calm full-viewport bookends, a dense table, a short 420px numbers band, then a tall asymmetric projects section.

Today all six sections are the same height, centred, in the same frame. That sameness is the actual complaint behind "bland" — not a lack of decoration.

B — SHOW THE WORK (highest value)

The featured project carries a real retrieval-pipeline diagram: ingest offline in grey, live query in red, the LLM in the terminal black. Drawn as inline SVG in the existing hairline-and-mono idiom, so it costs no library and no bundle.

The other five are asymmetric — 1.35/1/1 then 1/1.35 — rather than a uniform stack.

C — MAKE THE NUMBERS THE HERO

All four figures exist today, buried in project body text where nobody reads them. Pulled out into a short band in the pixel face, each traceable to a project below.

This band is the shortest frame on the canvas on purpose — arriving after a full-height section, its shortness is the jolt.

OPEN QUESTIONS FOR YOU

1. EXPERIENCE now reads as a table with a "What shipped" column — those tags are my summary, not your words. Worth checking.
2. The language-study year is shown as a row of its own rather than a gap. Deliberate; tell me if you would rather it were quieter.
3. Company names carry 株式会社 here. Consistent with the JA copy — say if you want them Latin-only in EN.

D, E and F from the brief are NOT drawn yet — they are upside, and the brief says re-measure after A.
